definitions.full: H793. eshed אֶ֫שֶׁד noun [masculine] foundation, bottom, lower part (slope) (Assyrian išdu compare Lotz TP 186 ; > others from אֲשַׁד , pour , Sabean אסד = מסקי (משׁקה) DHM ZMG 1883, 8, whence fall, slope ; compare Di Num 21:15 ) ׳א הַנְּחָלִים the bottom of the ravines 21:15 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to pour ;
